shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with live see-through air, cross-level work AI, and linked weather.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency).
- Cap: 3 levels per column, enforced in LevelMapGen and PlaceWorker_ABStairs.
- Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics (documented deviations: floor removal only drops on exposed air; bomb rooftop holes deferred).
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock matching surface geology, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches; HarmonyBoot per-class patching; fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (end of T2.3)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps (ground comp = column controller + per-map stair registry); stairs pairs generate levels on completion; use-stairs job with safe transfer; PageUp/PageDown camera-preserving level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, walkable ledge ring, two lit unroofed face rows, fogged thick-roofed core, guaranteed fog reveal on mining; landings mine out and unfog their 3x3.
- See-below renderer: surface section submeshes at y=-2.5 (knowledge layers excluded BY TYPE); air-cells-only light mask (base dim + real per-cell light, night cap 62%, padded world-anchored grid); live dynamic things below; far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof below governs rooftop above; sky floors write roofs below; things over air fall.
- Cross-level work: idle colonists virtually scan linked levels at the stairwell exit (field swap restored in finally, recursion-guarded, per-pawn 1200-tick cooldown, lord/drafted/downed excluded) and take the stairs when work exists, re-scanning on arrival. CRITICAL FIX: the think tree runs an emergency JobGiver_Work instance FIRST with a near-empty giver list; the migration postfix must skip it or it burns the cooldown every cycle and the real scan never runs (saved to lore).
- Idle return (T2.3): colonists idle on any level with no work anywhere take the stairs toward the surface (settings toggle, same cooldown), so work levels never collect roaming pawns and they drift home to food and beds.
- Drafted movement: go up / go down gizmos through the nearest linked stairwell.
- Stairs placement: all levels within the cap; links to existing levels validate the matching target spot; graceful unlinked fallback with message.

## Quadruple pass log
T2 series: emergency-instance starvation found via bridge diagnostics and fixed (verified in-game: work=found, pawn ascended and mined); idle return terminates by construction (surface pawns never return-migrate). Confidence: cross-level work 90% (verified live), idle return 90%, drafted gizmos 90%, stair registry 92%, placement validation 90%.
Known gaps (T3): pawns do not cross levels for FOOD, REST, or JOY; cross-map stockpiles/hauling; prioritized right-click work across levels; multi-hop migration is organic via the surface.

## Tranche plan
- T0, T1 series, T2 series DONE pending final sign-off.
- T3: logistics: cross-map stockpiles/hauling (user-flagged), storage awareness, bills across levels, cross-level needs.
- T4: systems: temperature sync, power across levels, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling; renderer polish backlog.

## Status
T2.3 compiled green, pushed. Pending: idle-return verification, then T3.
